heading: About us
subheading: The Complete Restoration Company are award winning experts in the field of building restoration and conservation.
lead: Our high quality work can be seen all over the home counties and London.
bodyHtml:
The Complete Restoration Company is a traditional company that has been trading for over 35 years. Our ethos is that we pride ourselves on our high standard of finish and our attention to detail.

We are an efficient and professional company who offer traditional values and service.

We are a value for return supplier who will always ensure that any project is completed to the excellent standard that our reputation has been built on.
testimonial: The Complete Restoration Company brings period beauty back to life, making sure each project or item fits perfectly for contemporary or traditional living and design.
